function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT vendor_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-09' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) -
       SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-08' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS delta_qty
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY vendor_id
ORDER BY delta_qty DESC","purpose":"Quantity change by vendor"}
